messages:
alex: Heads-up: mid-Q OKR micro report card. Drop quick status (shipped / slipped / blocker) + owner + ETA for each milestone below. Keep it bullets. I'll synthesize. @mira @dan @priya @ryan
mira: Shipped — model-profiling dashboard. PR merged (#1234). Owner: Mira. Baseline perf uploaded. :tada:
dan: Slipped — autoscale v2 rollout. Hit infra driver regression on 2.3, causing pod restarts. Owner: Dan. ETA: +2w for stable rollback plan.
dan: logs snippet: ```kernel: driver oom on boot: nvlink timeout```
priya: In progress — dedicated onboarding flow (docs + e2e). Docs shipped, e2e failing on auth mock. Owner: Priya. ETA: next Tue for full pass.
ryan: Code review note — I can take Mira's PR today, will prioritize. Also will prep a canary plan for autoscale fallback.
alex: Blockers to call out: infra sign-off for canary policy (Dan), product acceptance tests for private deploy (Priya). If either stalls we need a rollback cadence.
priya: Need a test account from infra to repro e2e failures. @dan can you provision a temp tenant? Otherwise ETA shifts.
dan: Will create temp tenant and creds by EOD. Creating placeholder: `s3://rbwd-temp/tenants/qa` (placeholder link, will DM creds).
alex: Next steps (owners / due dates): Mira — close profiling by EOW; Dan — rollback plan + canary policy by Thu; Priya — temp tenant by EOD, full e2e pass by Tue; Ryan — CR + canary trigger once infra confirms. I'll bundle this for exec summary.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary created for mira/model-profiling at 3624510000 :rocket:
ryan: Ack. I'll schedule the CR + trigger canary after Dan confirms tenant.
mira: Quick follow-up — I'll add a perf-regression alert to Console dashboards. Will open a small PR after CR lands.
alex: Perfect. If anything else slips, flag here and tag me. Thanks team :thumbsup:
